title: Difflicit project
description: difflicit.json (or analysis.json) at the root of a folder or repository makes it a Difflicit project. It holds artifacts, whose versions you diff, and links the project's notes. Stored *.diff / *.patch files work too.

project.description: The id of the project, as the Difflicit instance names it, e.g. CVE-2024-54494 on xnu.ivx.run. Defaults to the folder name.

notes.description: The project's notes, relative to the project: Markdown, ideally diffmd (Markdown whose diff fences are shown as patch diffs). Defaults to README.diffmd, then README.md. See https://ivx.run/docs/difflicit/diffmd/

artifacts.description: The things this project compares. Each has versions; you diff two versions of one artifact.

oneOf.description: A git repository; its versions are its tags and commits.

repo.description: Path to the repository inside the project, e.g. artifacts/xnu.

oneOf.description: A file or folder; its versions are the copies added to it.

image.description: The dyld_shared_cache image its versions were extracted from, e.g. /usr/lib/libobjc.A.dylib.

path.description: Path to this version inside the project, e.g. artifacts/libobjc/951.7.0.0.0.
